title: SpeakFi
tagline: Bridging and swapping with one voice command. Speak once, we handle the chains for you
description: This project combines AI and Web3 infrastructure to allow bridging and swapping of tokens with one voice command. Speak once, and the AI picks the intent from your statement to form a swapping route and execute swaps without you thinking of chains and bridges. This reduces the need to manually switch from one chain to another
how_its_made: The project uses LIFI to find the best routes for bridging and swapping. It also uses AI to capture, transcript and create the intent object from the voice captured. The project shows how AI and Web3 can unlock more ease in the DeFi ecosystem.  Behind the scenes, ENS is also used.
